name: Myanmar
value: Airstrike on Rakhine IDP camp killed 12, 13 Nov
summary: Witnesses say a military airstrike killed 12 at a Rakhine displacement camp on 13 Nov; no major city changed hands
state: Witnesses and a rescue group said a military airstrike on the Byar La displacement camp in Ponnagyun township, Rakhine State, killed 12 people, including a five-year-old, and injured 18 on 13 Nov; AFP could not reach the military for comment (Arab News). Rakhine is largely held by the Arakan Army and blockaded by the military, and ACLED estimates over 100,000 people have been killed since the 2021 coup. Searches on 18 Nov found no major city changing hands or cross-border escalation, so Watch holds.
for_you: Anyone travelling to Myanmar should check FCDO travel advice. Those most exposed are civilians in conflict areas, especially displaced people in Rakhine.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen or cross-border escalation (Alert line)

sources.title: Arab News (AFP) — Myanmar airstrike on displaced persons camp kills 12: witnesses
